title: Small businesses face June 1 deadline for federal drought disaster loans | Preston County News | wvnews.com
text:
CLARKSBURG, W.Va. — The U.S. Small Business Administration is reminding West Virginia small businesses and private nonprofit organizations that June 1 is the deadline to apply for low-interest federal disaster loans to offset economic losses caused by a drought that began Sept. 23, 2025.
The Economic Injury Disaster Loan program is available to eligible small businesses, small agricultural cooperatives, nurseries, and private nonprofits, including faith-based organizations, with financial losses directly related to the disaster. While the SBA cannot provide loans to most agricultural producers, farmers, or ranchers, aquaculture enterprises are eligible to apply.
